projects.rai-national-center-for-public-: Field survey application · King Abdulaziz Center
Official client organization website · not the survey app

Offline-first field survey collection for the National Center for Public Opinion Polls (Rai), part of the King Abdulaziz Center for Cultural Communication, with GPS, QR device custody and background synchronization.
Support field workflows without relying on constant connectivity, preserve local records and synchronize collected data when a connection is available.
